_meta.openai/widgetDescription: iPayX FX forensic audit result. Shows FX Score, spread, overpayment vs mid-market benchmark.

description: Produces a full FX audit report for one transaction (score, spread, estimated loss, breakdown and routing recommendation). Inputs: amount, currency_from, currency_to, bank_rate, optional company_name. Requires a Bearer API key from https://www.ipayx.ai/ai-access.

examples.name: Full forensic for a quarterly EUR payment batch

company_name.description: Optional company name for the report

name: full_forensic_fx_report
